item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.2
item.description: - The menu bar icon now flashes lime the moment a paste is matched, so you can see it worked. - ⌘Q closes the panel or About window, and ConformTXT keeps running in the menu bar. To quit, right-click the icon and choose Quit, or press ⌥⌘Q. - New: Keep images (on). Pictures in what you copy now come along with the text, sized to fit. - New: Remove emoji (off). Takes emoji out of what you paste and closes up the space they leave. - Keep headings big now matches how big headings were where you copied them, and uses a gentler size for AI chats, so headings no longer come in oversized. - Pasting into a one-line box (a link box, To or Subject, a search bar, a form field) is now a normal paste, instantly: those boxes can't hold formatting. - Fixed: in Mimestream and Mail, pasted text could come in a size too big and, in replies, in a serif font. ConformTXT now sends your font along with the right size.
